principle: least privilege; every export, purge, publication and redaction is approved by a named human

researcher.description: Runs searches, extracts claims and drafts from approved sources.

editor.description: Edits and proofreads drafts and translations.

translator.description: Produces and reviews translations against terminology and memory.

domain-reviewer.description: Confirms subject-matter accuracy and claim support.

approver.description: Approves publication, export, archive signing and destructive actions.

auditor.description: Reads the audit chain, registries and provenance records.

admin.description: Manages workspaces, retention and incident response.

separation_of_duties.rule: the actor who drafted an artifact may not be the approving actor for its publication
